newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash Jan wheat firms after world markets.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash Jan wheat firms after world markets.

text.p: Argentine January cash wheat firmed in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange midsession, tracking firmer world prices, traders said.

April cash maize rose in good trade in a rebound after recent declines. Spot maize firmed in thin trade. May cash soybeans also rose in a technical rebound, in middling turnover. Spot sunflower seed firmed in medium volume, with good demand by crushers to feed oil shipments. March sunseed also rose, in good volume.
